text_block_list.text:
One day, on our way back from going 
shopping in the commercial district 
together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My, what a lovely, lively atmosphere. A 
lottery raffle, is it?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"You there, Umamusume! Don't be shy! Come 
try your luck at the raffle before you 
go~!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My... hehe. Since you're offering, would 
you mind if I joined in?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I received one while doing some 
shopping earlier.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I wonder if I'll win 
anything...♪

Victoire Pisa eagerly cranked the raffle 
machine lever!
And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Huh... WHAT?!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I never in my wildest dreams thought I'd 
win the "Hot Springs Trip Ticket"...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Fufu, yes! Thank you very much♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: A hot spring trip... I'm so happy.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right. Would you like to come 
along too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, absolutely. It seems these are pair 
tickets, after all.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"In a hot spring town drifting with steam, 
seeing the same sights, eating the same 
food, soaking in the waters together..."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Relaxing together and finding peace in the 
same things...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
A day like that sounds truly wonderful. 
What do you think?

I wondered if I ought to decline, but... 
after they went this far to invite me, 
turning them down felt wrong.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Oh my♪ Thank you very much...!

And so, once the Twinkle Series had 
settled down, we went on a hot spring trip 
together.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My...♪ Fufu, I did it. And what a 
wonderful aroma...♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —That's right.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Um, Trainer-san. Would you like to eat 
together if you're up for it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, of course. Food always tastes better 
when shared between two.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Besides— I just thought of something nice.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Here is the marinated hors d'oeuvre. 
Please enjoy its appetizing, tangy flavor.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Next up is the potage. Its gentle 
sweetness and richness pair wonderfully 
with the hamburg steak's demi-glace sauce.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
And now, at long last... Here is your 
hamburger steak.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... just kidding. They're all just 
simple things I threw together, though.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Since we have the chance, I'd love to join 
in on the culinary circle.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Besides... whenever we received fine food, 
my mother used to do this for me too from 
time to time.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Carpaccio for the appetizer, and consommé 
for the soup.

text_block_list.name: Pisa's Mother
text_block_list.text: "And next, the main dish: chicken steak!"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to share with you the joy I felt 
back then...♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. Now, we have plenty of dishes here, 
so shall we dig right in...?♪

The Salisbury steak we ate that day paired 
wonderfully with the marinade and potage, 
delivering a wonderfully comforting 
flavor.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Oh, I'm so happy...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Still... it's amazing. Fufu, so very many.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
It looks very delicious, but I don't think 
I could finish it alone.
choice_data_list:
Wouldn't your friends be happy if you 
shared it with them?

Don't you think your friends would be 
happy if you shared it with them?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...You're right. I'll bring some back to 
the dorm and share it around."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
—What do you mean, a massive pile of 
carrots?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I won it in the raffle, and if you'd 
like—

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"No, wait, wait! Is this divine 
providence...?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The truth is—right now in my room, there 
is a 5kg bag of potatoes.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Why, you ask? It's a prize from a game 
sweepstake. No one would ever expect to 
actually win one, right?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see. So that's why you're making a 
massive batch of curry, huh?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for calling you over. It just 
didn't seem like the two of us could 
handle it alone.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I have calculated the recipe for ten times 
the normal amount. Please strictly adhere 
to the measurements, especially for the 
water and roux.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I hope everyone will be happy with 
it...♪

That night, the cafeterias of both the 
Miho and Rittō dorms were filled with 
handmade curry prepared by the students.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: My, a single carrot...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, how lovely. The color of the peel is 
so vivid, too—... Oh, I know.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: There was something I wanted to try out.
(Scrunch, scrunch, scrunch, scrunch...)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Just a little more, just a little more—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...! It's done!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I managed to peel an entire carrot in one 
unbroken strip...♪

All in all, the kinpira made afterwards 
using the peels as well was absolutely 
delicious.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~
Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Oh my...! So it's a blank, huh?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
What a shame, but... —these are still some 
lovely tissues.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Looks like I won't have any trouble wiping 
away spilt tears. I'll cherish and accept 
this.

Victoire Pisa carefully put away the pack 
of pocket tissues she had won.
